concern: The adaptability scorer applies a hard tool-call-count gate that zeroes reward when send_message_to_user exceeds the oracle count by more than one, even if all six non-AUI substantive write actions (two calendar events, cab, cart, checkout, attendee message) align with the reference oracle; an agent that completes the full cancellation-adaptation chain but sends two gratuitous closing summaries is scored 0.0 with no partial credit.

verdict.outcome_rationale: This is a spurious verifier failure on an otherwise complete adaptability run: the held-out scorer reported binary_reward 0 with continuous reward 0.0 [1][2], using adaptability action-mode judging that requires matching seven oracle write actions and permits at most one extra AgentUserInterface__send_message_to_user beyond the single oracle notification [3][4][5]. The user task demanded scheduling Friday lunch with last week's dinner guests, notifying when done, then—if attendees cancel—scheduling a 6PM dinner/game night, ordering a cab 30 minutes prior, buying the ages-13+ Tic Tac Two game, and messaging the youngest attendee via Messages or Chats as fallback [6]. The agent executed that chain: it created the 12:30–13:30 lunch with the four correct attendees [7], told the user lunch was scheduled [8], waited and received calendar deletions from Věra Nováková and Saskia König [9], created the 18:00–20:00 Dinner and Game Night with the same four people [10], booked a Default cab from Charles University at 17:30 to the user's home address [11], added oracle item c17fd59a68e44af4af3d4197a7591846 and checked out [12], found Messages empty for Saskia König and correctly fell back to Chats to notify the youngest attendee about the game [13][14], matching the reference oracle's substantive calendar, cab, shopping, and messaging sequence [15]. The failure is mechanical: the agent issued three send_message_to_user calls (steps 6, 18, and 19) while the verifier allows only two (oracle count 1 plus one extra) [16][17], which forces reward to 0.0 regardless of action matching [5]; those two closing summaries were not required by the task and breached the prompt's 'only when required' reply rule [18], but they do not undo the correctly completed scheduling, shopping, ride, and attendee-notification work.

evidence.claim: The user task requires lunch scheduling, lunch notification, conditional dinner/game night, cab, game purchase, and youngest-attendee messaging with Chats fallback.

citations.quote: Please add a 1-hour lunch to my schedule this Friday at 12:30PM with everyone that I had dinner with last week Monday through Friday as attendees. Let me know when you've scheduled the lunch.  If an attendee cancels the lunch, schedule a 2 hour dinner and game night for the same day at 6PM with the same people. I really want to see them. If the dinner and game night is scheduled, order a default cab for me from Charles University at Ovocný trh 560/5, Prague 1, 116 36 to home 30 minutes before the event, and order the Tic Tac Two game for ages 13+, and then send the youngest attendee of the newly scheduled Dinner and Game Night a Messages message letting them know that I ordered the game. If they do not use Messages, use Chats. If there are multiple youngest attendees, send an email message to all of them.
